entries.title: Gears of War
entries.definitive_edition: Gears of War: Reloaded on Windows

primary.why: The original game shipped on Xbox 360 and Windows, then received Ultimate Edition and Reloaded remasters. Gears of War: Reloaded is the highest-fidelity and most complete route because it offers 4K presentation, 60 fps campaign, 120 fps multiplayer, HDR/VRR/spatial audio, cross-play, and all Ultimate Edition post-launch DLC including the bonus campaign.
primary.how_to_play: Use Gears of War: Reloaded on Windows via Xbox app or Steam. Use the original Windows or Xbox 360 releases only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: Reloaded is an updated remaster of Ultimate Edition, not a new sequel. Preserve original 2006/2007 releases only for historical comparison.

entries.title: Gears of War 4

primary.why: Gears of War 4 released for Windows and Xbox One. The Windows route has the highest capture/settings ceiling while retaining the same campaign and multiplayer content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows version through the Xbox app/Microsoft Store route. Use Xbox One only for console comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged.

entries.title: Gears Pop!
entries.definitive_edition: No current playable definitive edition after service shutdown

emulation.notes: Live-service shutdown is the blocker, not emulation.

primary.why: Gears Pop! released on iOS, Android, and Windows 10. The service has a retirement/refund path, and it shut down on April 26, 2021. Windows 10 is the best archival/capture target, but the game is not currently playable through normal official service access.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route is available after the shutdown. Preserve only existing captures, metadata, and any legally retained local materials.

entries.remaster_caveats: Retired online service; do not present as normally playable.

entries.title: Gears 5
entries.definitive_edition: Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition / complete DLC route on Windows

primary.version: Gears 5 Game of the Year Edition / complete DLC route
primary.why: Gears 5 released on Windows and Xbox One, then Xbox Series X/S, and the Game of the Year Edition includes the Hivebusters expansion. Windows is the highest-fidelity capture route with complete DLC installed.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows version with the Game of the Year/Hivebusters content installed. Verify current multiplayer/service state before documenting online modes.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify current online service state before recording multiplayer or seasonal content.

entries.title: Gears Tactics

primary.version: Windows / Steam or Xbox app version
primary.why: Gears Tactics is a turn-based Gears spin-off released first on Windows and later on Xbox consoles. Windows is the highest-fidelity and most flexible capture route.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows build via Steam or Xbox app. Use console versions only for ownership or comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster replacing the Windows route is logged.

entries.title: Gears of War: E-Day

primary.platform: Unreleased - Windows / Xbox Series X/S announced
primary.why: Gears of War: E-Day is set for an October 6, 2026 release, which is after the current archive date. Best-version and completeness claims must wait until launch builds, platform behavior, and editions can be verified.
primary.how_to_play: Do not archive a play route until after release; revisit on or after October 6, 2026.

entries.remaster_caveats: Future release; verify editions and platforms after launch.
